nodes.description: Private owner address; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as the privileged access check in delegate, init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and _mints.
Public mapping of holder balances, mutated by transferFrom, _mints, batchSend and the constructor.
Public nested mapping of allowances, written by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Mapping whitelist flag consulted by ensure and set to true by _mints.
Mapping counting how many times an address has sold, checked by condition and incremented in transferFrom.
Minimum sale amount in token units, set by init and enforced in condition.
Maximum sale amount in token units, set by init and enforced in condition.
Allowed number of sales per address, set by init and enforced in condition.
Arbitrary trusted trading address, settable by owner via setTradeAddress and whitelisted in ensure.
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Constant decimals (18) used to scale values in _mints and init.
Token name set in the constructor.
Token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant Uniswap router address, hardcoded as a whitelisted source in ensure.
transfer(address,uint) payable entry point that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,...).
ensure(address,address,uint) internal whitelist gate: returns true for owner/tradeAddress/UNI/pair/canSale entries, otherwise delegates to condition.
transferFrom(address,address,uint) payable; performs allowance check, ensure gate and unchecked balance bookkeeping.
approve(address,uint) payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition(address,uint) internal sale-limit check using _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
delegate(address,bytes) payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall execution.
_mints(address,uint) privilege-mint function setting balanceOf and canSale for a spender.
init(uint,uint,uint) owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
batchSend(address[],uint) owner-only mass transfer loop with unchecked total and balance subtraction.
setTradeAddress(address) owner-only setter of tradeAddress, a whitelisted source in ensure.
pairFor(factory,tokenA,tokenB) internal pure CREATE2-style pair address computation.
Constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, balanceOf[owner] and a max allowance to the Uniswap router.
msg.sender used as caller identity for transfer, transferFrom, approve, constructor and the balance/allowance index.
msg.sender checked against owner in delegate().
msg.sender checked against owner or a hardcoded address in _mints().
msg.sender checked against owner in init().
msg.sender checked against owner in batchSend().
msg.sender checked against owner in setTradeAddress().
Low-level delegatecall to an owner-supplied address with attacker-controllable calldata, executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.
balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom without SafeMath, allowing arithmetic overflow.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom without SafeMath, allowing arithmetic underflow.
_onSaleNum[_from]++ in transferFrom without overflow protection.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend without SafeMath, allowing arithmetic underflow.
Parameter _to of transfer(), the recipient address.
Parameter _value of transfer(), the amount to send.
Parameter _from of transferFrom(), the source account.
Parameter _to of transferFrom(), the destination account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom(), the amount moved.
Parameter _spender of approve(), the allowance beneficiary.
Parameter _value of approve(), the allowance amount.
Parameter a of delegate(), the delegatecall target contract.
Parameter b of delegate(), the arbitrary calldata passed to delegatecall.
Parameter spender of _mints(), the address receiving minted balance and canSale flag.
Parameter addedValue of _mints(), the balance assigned to spender.
Parameter saleNum of init(), the per-address sale count limit.
Parameter token of init(), the minimum sale amount before scaling.
Parameter maxToken of init(), the maximum sale amount before scaling.
Parameter _tos of batchSend(), the array of recipients.
Parameter _value of batchSend(), the per-recipient amount.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress(), the new whitelisted trading address.
Local _UNI in ensure(), the computed Uniswap pair address used in the whitelist comparison.
Local total in batchSend(), computed as _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
Loop counter i in batchSend().
Local _to in batchSend(), the current recipient taken from _tos.
Local pair in pairFor(), the computed deterministic pair address.

edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the sender argument when transfer() forwards to transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared with _from to decide whether to consume an allowance in transferFrom.
delegate() enforces require(msg.sender == owner), all privilege depends on caller identity.
_mints() enforces msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded address before minting balances.
init() enforces require(msg.sender == owner) before rewriting sale limits.
batchSend() enforces require(msg.sender == owner) before mass transfers.
setTradeAddress() enforces require(msg.sender == owner) before whitelisting an address.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, anchoring all later access control.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping that is decremented without SafeMath.
msg.sender indexes the balance mapping written with unchecked addition.
delegate() performs an arbitrary delegatecall, executing external attacker code inside this contract's storage context.
The target address a supplied by the owner flows directly into the delegatecall target.
The calldata b flows directly into the delegatecall, giving full control over executed logic.
transfer() delegates all work to transferFrom(msg.sender,...).
transferFrom() calls ensure() as its whitelist gate.
transferFrom writes balanceOf[_to] += _value without overflow protection.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without underflow protection.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] without overflow protection.
_from parameter controls the source account used throughout transferFrom.
_to parameter controls the destination account used throughout transferFrom.
_value parameter is the amount moved and checked in transferFrom.
_from indexes the _onSaleNum counter that is incremented unchecked.
_value is added to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
_value is subtracted from the allowance without SafeMath.
_to indexes the balance mapping that receives the unchecked addition.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
_to parameter of transfer() is forwarded as the recipient.
_value parameter of transfer() is forwarded as the amount.
_spender parameter determines the allowance key in approve().
_value parameter is stored as the allowance in approve().
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve() uses msg.sender as the owner of the allowance.
ensure() calls pairFor() to compute the Uniswap pair address for the whitelist check.
ensure() falls through to condition() when the address is not whitelisted.
ensure() compares _from/_to against owner.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] for the whitelist shortcut.
ensure() compares _from against tradeAddress.
ensure() compares _from against the hardcoded UNI router constant.
Local _UNI computed in ensure() is used in the whitelist comparison.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition() enforces _minSale against _value.
condition() enforces _maxSale against _value.
condition() reads _saleNum as the per-address sale limit.
pairFor() assigns the computed address to the local pair.
spender parameter is the address granted balance and canSale in _mints().
addedValue parameter is scaled and written to balanceOf in _mints().
_mints() writes balanceOf[spender].
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true, bypassing the sale gate.
_mints() uses decimals to scale the minted amount.
saleNum parameter is written to _saleNum in init().
token parameter is scaled and written to _minSale in init().
maxToken parameter is scaled and written to _maxSale in init().
init() writes the _minSale state variable.
init() writes the _maxSale state variable.
init() writes the _saleNum state variable.
init() uses decimals to scale the sale limits.
The _tos array parameter drives the batchSend loop.
The _value parameter is the per-recipient amount in batchSend.
batchSend() subtracts the computed total from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath.
batchSend() reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
total = _value * _tos.length is computed with unchecked multiplication.
The unchecked local total feeds the unchecked balance subtraction.
The loop counter i controls iteration in batchSend().
The current recipient _to is used in the unchecked balance bookkeeping of batchSend().
addr parameter is stored into the tradeAddress state variable.
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
Constructor writes the name state variable.
Constructor writes the symbol state variable.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied supply.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the full supply.
Constructor grants the Uniswap router a max allowance in the allowance mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is an argument of transfer() and only meaningful within that function.
_value is an argument of transfer() and only meaningful within that function.
_from identifies the source account processed by transferFrom().
_to is the index of the unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value update.
_value is the unchecked amount added to balanceOf[_to].
_spender is the allowance key written by approve().
_value is the allowance amount written by approve().
Parameter a is the delegatecall target, so it belongs to the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Parameter b is the delegatecall calldata consumed by the unsafe delegatecall operation.
spender is the address credited by _mints().
addedValue is the balance value assigned by _mints().
saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init().
token is stored into _minSale by init().
maxToken is stored into _maxSale by init().
The _tos array drives the recipient loop of batchSend().
_value is the per-recipient amount used by batchSend().
addr is the value assigned to tradeAddress by setTradeAddress().
Local _UNI is computed and compared only inside the whitelist gate ensure().
Local total feeds the unchecked balanceOf subtraction in batchSend().
Loop counter i exists only within batchSend().
Local _to is the recipient whose balance is updated inside batchSend().
Local pair is the return value computed by pairFor().
